statement.p: Evaluate the line integral \int_{\mathcal{C}} \mathbf{F} \cdot \,d\ \mathbf{r} where \mathbf{F}=\left\lt 5 \sin x, -2 \cos y, 5 xz \right> and \mathcal{C} is the path given by \mathbf{r}(t) = (-2 t^3, -2 t^2, 3 t) for 0 \le t \le 1

static.solution:
\mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) = \left\lt 5 \sin (-2 t^3), -2 \cos (-2 t^2), -30 t^4 \right> \mathbf{r} '(t) = \left\lt -6 t^2, -4 t, 3 \right > \mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{r} '(t) = \left\lt 5 \sin (-2 t^3), -2 \cos (-2 t^2), -30 t^4 \right> \cdot \left\lt -6 t^2, -4 t, 3 \right > =-30 t^2 \sin (-2 t^3) + 8 t \cos (-2 t^2) - 90 t^4
The line integral is then: \int_{\mathcal{C}} \mathbf{F} \cdot \,d\ \mathbf{r} = \int^1_0 \mathbf{F}(\mathbf{r}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{r} '(t) \ dt = \int^1_0 -30 t^2 \sin (-2 t^3) + 8 t \cos (-2 t^2) - 90 t^4\ dt = \left [ -5 \cos (-2 t^3) - 2 \sin (-2 t^2) - 18 t^5 \right ]^1_0 = -5 \cos (-2) - 2 \sin (-2) - 13
